toegepas.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
toegepas.voor: Shaka het baie van sy ma Nandi gehou.
toegepas.na: Shaka was baie lief vir sy ma Nandi.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Lief vir' is the natural idiom for love of a mother; 'baie van ... gehou' sounds flat.
toegepas.fout: 'baie van sy ma gehou' is flat for a son's love of his mother
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Was baie lief vir' is the natural Afrikaans for this and keeps the meaning.

toegepas.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Verslae uit daardie tyd' is the idiomatic way to say reports from that period.
toegepas.fout: 'verslae van die tyd' copies English 'reports of the time'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Verslae uit daardie tyd' is the idiomatic way to name contemporary accounts; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
toegepas.voor: Mense wat nie wou luister nie is gedood
toegepas.na: Mense wat nie wou luister nie, is gedood
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma after the embedded clause separates 'nie' from the main verb and makes the sentence easier to read.
toegepas.fout: the embedded clause ending in 'nie' runs straight into the main verb and makes the reader stumble
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma closes the relative clause before 'is gedood' and reads more easily, without changing meaning.

toegepas.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dit' refers back to the plural 'verslae' loosely; naming them is clearer and avoids reading 'dit' as the exaggeration.
toegepas.fout: 'dit' can be read as the exaggerated 'dinge' rather than the reports
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming 'dié verslae' removes the ambiguity and keeps the meaning.

toegepas.blok: Shaka se dood en sy nalatenskap
toegepas.voor: het dit saam met Mbopha gedoen
toegepas.na: het die moord saam met Mbopha gepleeg
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dit gedoen' is vague; naming the deed is clearer without repeating 'vermoor'.
toegepas.fout: 'dit gedoen' is a vague verb for a murder
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die moord gepleeg' is the exact fixed expression and names the same deed.

toegepas.blok: Wat gebly het en wat verander het
toegepas.voor: Die manier waarop gemeenskappe ingerig was en leiers se mag het wel baie verander.
toegepas.na: Leiers se mag en die manier waarop gemeenskappe ingerig was, het wel baie verander.
toegepas.rede_vinder: In the original 'en leiers se mag' reads as part of the relative clause; putting it first makes the double subject clear.
toegepas.fout: 'en leiers se mag' reads as part of the relative clause, so the double subject is unclear
toegepas.rede_keurder: Putting 'leiers se mag' first makes both subjects clear with the same meaning.

laat_vaar.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Avoids 'afgedwing ... te dwing' in the same sentence; 'reëls opgelê' is the natural collocation.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Afgedwing' (enforced) and 'opgelê' (imposed) say different things, so the meaning moves.

laat_vaar.blok: Shaka se dood en sy nalatenskap
laat_vaar.na: terwyl Shaka se leërs weg was
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: After three other men are named, 'sy' could point to Mbopha or a half-brother; naming Shaka removes the ambiguity.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The sentence opens with 'Sy halfbroers', so the parallel 'sy leërs' clearly means Shaka; the change adds a repeated name without need.

laat_vaar.blok: Shaka se dood en sy nalatenskap
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Hul eie huis opsit' is the natural form of the idiom.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: ''n eie huis opsit' is already natural Afrikaans; the proposal is a lateral move.

na_skrywer.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: AWS writes compounds as one word; the hyphen is not needed here (note: the protected word 'rou' stays inside the compound).
na_skrywer.fout: the compound is hyphenated without need, unlike 'routydperk' in the same lesson
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: AWS writes the compound as one word; the protected 'rou' stays intact inside it.
na_skrywer.waarom: not applied: it changes the protected wording 'rou', which must stay as it is; fix the fault without changing those words

vlae.blok: Shaka se dood en sy nalatenskap
vlae.teks: Mbopha was een van Shaka se naaste dienaars (lyfwag).
vlae.rede: The bare '(lyfwag)' in brackets reads unclearly: it is not plain whether Mbopha was a bodyguard or 'lyfwag' is a gloss for 'dienaars'. A writer should say it in a full phrase; I did not guess which is meant.
